name: CoinsPaid
rootCause: Cryptocurrency payment service provider Coinspaid experienced multiple unauthorized transactions, with hackers stealing cryptocurrency assets worth $7.5 million.

descriptions.text: Cryptocurrency payment service provider Coinspaid experienced multiple unauthorized transactions, with hackers stealing cryptocurrency assets worth $7.5 million.

CoinsPaid's hot wallet keys were compromised in January 2024, resulting in unauthorized withdrawals on Ethereum and BNB Chain totaling about $7.5 million. Attackers swiftly moved stolen assets through exchanges. Audited financial statements confirm losses and limited recovery, but primary chain-level withdrawal evidence remains unavailable. Direct compromise of operational hot wallet private keys, due to inadequate wallet access controls, allowed attackers to withdraw assets without restriction. No contract code vulnerability was involved.
